_note: 1.3.0 training (owner brainstorm, approved 2026-09-25; docs/design/training.md). Two tracks, Mana pool (Vitals.Mana_max) and Stamina (Vitals.Stamina_max). All numbers are percent of {{user}}'s starting value on that track (base). One session = session_pct x (1 + partner bonuses); at most weekly_pct a week (after bonuses); at most total_pct over the whole campaign. Partner bonuses (Rank 5 gifts, data/bond_rewards.json train) add up and need the partner in the scene. One-time jumps (jump) ignore the weekly limit, never the total.
